title: NASA-UAP-D2, Apollo 17 Transcript, 1972
doc_notes: This is a NASA Apollo 17 mission transcript containing reports of unidentified flashing objects in space and on the lunar surface.

encounters.summary: Astronauts observed unidentified bright, flashing objects in space while maneuvering, initially speculating they were debris or S-IVB fragments.
encounters.entity_appearance: Bright, jagged, angular fragments or objects; some flashing rhythmically.
encounters.entity_behavior: Tumbling, drifting, or moving in a rhythmic flashing pattern.
encounters.quote: It is a bright object, and it's obviously rotating because it's flashing.

encounters.summary: Astronaut observed a bright flash on the lunar surface near the Grimaldi crater.
encounters.entity_appearance: Bright little flash and thin streak of light.
encounters.quote: Hey, I just saw a flash on the lunar surface!
